titulo: Three ways to say you leave at three
caption:
Three ways to say you leave at three

I used to check the time all through a chat. Then I started saying out at three.

Naming a limit up front lets the other person plan the time, and lets you stop watching it.

For whoever names the time limit up front.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right and a royal blue figure on the left that asks got a minute? in each of three labeled scenes. The glancer: a teal figure says sure. and glances sideways again and again while the blue one narrows its eyes. The bolt: a brown figure says sure. Gotta go! and walks off to the right while the blue one stares, wide-eyed. The heads-up: an ink-black figure says sure. and then out at three., and the blue one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of a hard stop. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
